about: This release's own additions to the carried hostgen.json (release_carry.py merges them): each with why.

func_V1_002A2450.why: v1.01's func_002A2450 (the blend pose a moby's animation change caches, called by func_002A7470) is rac2-decomp's func_US2_002A3288 (src/us2/game/002A3288.c, assembly), which the release table could not pair: 816 and 822 instructions, 99.2% the same with operands masked (six inserted, three changed). Without it the pose cache is never written and the hero's pose (func_L00_003181C0) reads garbage on Oozla
